schema:
CREATE TABLE users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        password TEXT NOT NULL,
        total_bounty INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

CREATE TABLE courses
    (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,
    language TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

CREATE TABLE progress (
       id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
       user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
       course_id TEXT NOT NULL,
       current_level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'easy',
       current_question_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
       completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
       session_questions TEXT,
       bounty_earned INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
       last_updated TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
       FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
       FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES courses(id)
    )

CREATE TABLE bounty_records (
       id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
       user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
       course_id TEXT NOT NULL,
       course_name TEXT NOT NULL,
       bounty INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
       completed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
       FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
    )

CREATE TABLE user_profiles (
       user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
       display_name TEXT,
       pirate_group TEXT,
       avatar TEXT DEFAULT 'luffy',
       FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
    )

CREATE TABLE questions (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        course_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        level TEXT NOT NULL,
        question_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
        question_text_1 TEXT NOT NULL,
        expected_output_1 TEXT NOT NULL,
        question_text_2 TEXT NOT NULL,
        expected_output_2 TEXT NOT NULL,
        question_text_3 TEXT NOT NULL,
        expected_output_3 TEXT NOT NULL,
        opponent_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        language TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES courses(id)
    )

CREATE TABLE question_rotation (
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, course_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            level TEXT NOT NULL, question_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
            last_alt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (last_alt BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
            PRIMARY KEY (user_id, course_id, level, question_number)
        )
